translations.title: Alvinnn!!! e i Chipmunks
translations.overview: Con un papà umano, uno scoiattolo appassionato di musica e i suoi fratelli si divertono a commettere bravate, imparando importanti lezioni di vita.

Everyone's favorite chipmunks -- Alvin, Simon and Theodore -- are back in this computer-animated version of the classic animated series. The brothers are famous rock stars who tour around the world with their best friends, the Chipettes.

overview.value: Dave gets temporary amnesia so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead.
Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a school speaker talks about the danger of germs.
Dave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes.
When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website, the chipettes prank Alvin back.
Theodore's teddy bear is bear-napped, forcing the boys to work with Officer Dangus to get him back.
Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, but Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.
Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, and goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend.
Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.
Simon creates a drone that can not only deliver pizzas, but has the ability to learn.
Alvin worries that the munks are responsible for making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star.
Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog and vows to get him back.
Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when her ideas are stolen.
Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game to see who's the best.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: The Karate Kidder
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Playing Favorites
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When Alvin suspects Simon is Dave's favorite, he and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race to win Dave's favor.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Back to Basics
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Everyone thinks Simon has lost his mind after he fails a school test and moves into a tree for some alone time.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Report Cards
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything he can to intercept the mail before Dave sees it.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: The Cat Sitter
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Theodore is stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats during a week that Dave wants the boys to focus only on school.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Addicted
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favorite things.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Spoiler-Itis
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When Alvin is accused of revealing spoilers for everyone's favorite TV show, he agrees not to speak for 24 hours.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Something Fishy
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they go all out to replace it before he notices.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Baby Mama Drama
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Alvin and Brittany learn parenting isn't easy when they have to care for a robot baby for a school assignment.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Ballet Boys
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When Alvin's soccer team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help with their conditioning.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Oh Brother Where Art Thou
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When Simon goes missing and nobody seems to remember who he is, Alvin worries that he is losing his mind.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: The Wall
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When some girls at school start debating who is the cutest chipmunk in the girls' bathroom, Alvin wants to be known as the cutest chipmunk.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: The Gift
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: It is Dave's birthday and Simon and Theodore have made gifts of Dave, meanwhile, Alvin did not.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Theo Knows Best
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has their own ideas on how the money should be spent.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: The Fugitives
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When the boys accidentally break Dave's new flat-screen TV, they decide to become fugitives on the lam.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Sherlock Chipmunk
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson when Theodore's teddy bear mysteriously disappears.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Independence Day
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Tired of taking orders from Dave, the boys move out and decide to build a tree house in the backyard.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Opposites Attract
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Alvin and Simon become magnetized and inseparable after an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Temporary Mom
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: When the boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a baby sitter, they each take a crack at finding a replacement.

tvdb:identity-season:3.title: Tee Fore Two
tvdb:identity-season:3.synopsis: Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.

overview.value: A favorite toy of Theodore's is lost on a rafting trip but then mysteriously shows up at the house, and it's alive.
Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life.
Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet. Is there something wrong with her - or her new glasses?
Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting sitting job with a spoiled four year old.
Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.
When Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother, he tries to be a better role model for Alvin and Simon.
Dave is thrilled when he thinks he's nominated for a Grammy, but it's actually an award for aging musicians.
When Theodore discovers Alvin and Simon have a secret club, he promises not to tell anyone if they let him join.
Dave promises to take Alvin to a water park if he gets a good grade on his test, but then a crow steals it.
When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, a therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger.
Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, so a therapist moves in;  when the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret.

The Chipmunks and Chipettes team up together to compete in a dodgeball tournament. They learned that an opposing team has an unfair advantage using technology. Later on, they discovered that an enraged Theodore could be their secret weapon.
Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in order to complete an art assignment for art class.
